proposed_definition: Batter-attributed runs divided by validated batter-faced balls, expressed per 100 balls.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Compare player pressure rate with that player's matched non-pressure rate; report eligible balls and uncertainty.
required_fields_or_evidence: Batter runs attribution; validated batter-faced classification; player, match, innings and delivery context.
known_readiness_status: Batter-faced and legal-ball coverage has major unresolved limitations; NOT READY for calculation.
proposed_use_control: Do not calculate until denominator and attribution coverage are independently validated.
approval_needed: Definition, pressure population, minimum sample and uncertainty method.

proposed_definition: Dismissals attributable to the batter divided by validated batter-faced balls; not-out and incomplete innings handled by an approved rule.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Compare within-player pressure and matched non-pressure rates; avoid interpreting a small number of dismissals as stable skill.
required_fields_or_evidence: Batter-faced balls; dismissal event and batter attribution; innings completion and not-out status.
known_readiness_status: NOT VERIFIED; depends on validated batter-faced and dismissal classification.
proposed_use_control: Candidate only; report uncertainty and exclusions; do not infer causation.
approval_needed: Dismissal taxonomy, denominator rules, sample and adjustment policy.

proposed_definition: Validated batter boundary events divided by validated batter-faced balls; exact boundary event definition to be approved.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Compare within-player pressure and matched non-pressure populations.
required_fields_or_evidence: Boundary event fields or approved derivation; batter-faced balls; player and context identifiers.
known_readiness_status: NOT VERIFIED; batter-faced coverage is unresolved and boundary definition must be validated.
proposed_use_control: Do not use until boundary and denominator evidence is reviewed.
approval_needed: Boundary definition, field mapping, thresholds and use.

proposed_definition: Bowler-conceded runs per six validated legal balls.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Compare within-bowler pressure and matched non-pressure populations, with role and phase context.
required_fields_or_evidence: Validated legal balls; conceded-run allocation including applicable extras; bowler attribution.
known_readiness_status: Full-population bowler-conceded runs are not feasible under existing evidence.
proposed_use_control: Do not present as a full-population metric; any restricted population requires separate approved feasibility evidence.
approval_needed: Feasible population, allocation rules, minimum sample and approval.

proposed_definition: Bowler-credit wickets per validated legal ball or other explicitly approved exposure unit.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Compare within-bowler pressure and matched non-pressure populations.
required_fields_or_evidence: Legal-ball classification; wicket events; bowler-credit attribution; bowler, match and context.
known_readiness_status: NOT VERIFIED; event and exposure definitions require validation.
proposed_use_control: Do not conflate dismissals with bowler-credit wickets.
approval_needed: Wicket-credit taxonomy, exposure unit, sample and use.

proposed_definition: Validated eligible balls with an approved zero-run outcome definition divided by eligible balls faced or bowled.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Compare within-player pressure and matched non-pressure populations using the same outcome definition.
required_fields_or_evidence: Legal-ball classification; runs credited to batter/team/bowler; extras allocation.
known_readiness_status: NOT READY until legal-ball coverage and zero-run definition are validated.
proposed_use_control: Keep team runs, batter runs, and bowler-conceded runs distinct.
approval_needed: Zero-run rule, denominator, sample and validation.

proposed_definition: For an approved metric, pressure-population estimate minus a comparable non-pressure estimate for the same player; units and direction follow that metric.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: Central proposed analytical contrast; pair with raw pressure and baseline values, sample sizes and uncertainty.
required_fields_or_evidence: All validated fields for the selected metric; pressure state; comparable role/phase/context.
known_readiness_status: NOT CALCULATED; depends on every selected metric being ready.
proposed_use_control: Descriptive association only unless a separately approved causal design supports more.
approval_needed: Metric set, matching/context controls, uncertainty and decision rule.

proposed_definition: Match outcome attached only at match level and used as an outcome label, not a delivery-time predictor.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: May support a separately approved validation question; not a player pressure metric by itself.
required_fields_or_evidence: Verified match identifier and result mapping; time-safe feature construction.
known_readiness_status: Conditionally usable only as a match-level label with leakage controls.
proposed_use_control: Exclude result/future information from pressure classification and predictor features.
approval_needed: Label use, leakage controls, validation design.

proposed_definition: Count of verified appearances, innings, or eligible opportunities, reported as exposure context only.
pressure_vs_baseline_comparison: May describe the number of pressure and baseline opportunities; not a performance difference.
required_fields_or_evidence: Verified participation and match/innings identifiers; explicit counting grain.
proposed_use_control: Never rank or infer performance from participation counts alone.
Do not use in this pressure-analysis plan.
approval_needed: Any reconsideration requires a separate project decision.
